positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description:
Creating a wireless sensor framework for visually impaired people.
Using a Raspberry Pi 4 with a camera module to run a Computer Vision Algorithm receiving the same view as the user. The Raspberry Pi 4 will be wirelessly communicating via bluetooth with microcontrollers and vibration motors on a glove. The Computer Vision Algorithm is responsible for detecting unleveled floors and shadows. Depending on which glove vibrates, the user will be notified where the obstacle is in their view.
